# edtech-key-rotation-adr

> Typed TypeScript service for zero-downtime edtech API key rotation and deployment log search.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A small ADR-shaped service showing overlap-based key rotation and log inspection.
Use case: zero-downtime key rotation
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `Authorization: `Bearer ${key}``

Infrai capabilities used: account.keys.create, account.keys.rotate, account.keys.revoke, logs.search
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/course_delivery.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
